dailyTools.label: Daily writing tools navigation
dailyTools.backHelp: Return to the open manuscript. Unsaved tool input still needs saving or resetting.
dailyTools.helpIntro: These tools reuse the manuscript, save events and clues. No extra AI setup is needed.
dailyTools.help_dashboard: Manuscript saves refresh net additions; deletions are negative. Manual, AI-accepted and restored text stay separate. Goal and journal forms protect unsaved input.
dailyTools.help_focus: Start, pause or end the timer on the writing strip. Typewriter and sound switches are independent. Expiry only reminds; it never locks the manuscript.
dailyTools.help_replace: Choose book, volume or chapters and preview first. Proper names are protected by default. Writes require confirmation; later manuscript edits block unsafe batch undo.
dailyTools.help_clues: Filter status and overdue reminders, then locate source text. Plans stay separate from facts. Manual and bulk tracking edits affect author metadata only.
dailyTools.help_wellbeing: Off by default. Counts only focused foreground use with recent manuscript input, not writing time. Rest, snooze or mute for this run.
dailyTools.replaceKey: Ctrl+Shift+H: open replacement, prefilling a short manuscript selection when present.
dailyTools.searchKey: Ctrl+Enter in replacement: search only; never apply directly.
dailyTools.returnKey: Alt+Left in a source manuscript: return to replacement, clue or knowledge results.
dailyTools.saveKey: Ctrl+S or Ctrl+Enter in a dashboard goal/journal form: save that form.
dailyTools.focusKey: Ctrl+Alt+Enter in the manuscript: toggle focus layout.
dailyTools.helpSafety: Writes retain author confirmation and revision checks. Statistics never upload or enter AI context. Tools never commit Canon, State or Final automatically.
